issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Developer.attend: the problem statement and template declare an instance method attend(course: Course?) (problem_statement.md lines 43-47; template Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift line 34). The solution implements attend(course: Course?, forCredit: Bool) (solution Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift line 42) while Client.main() in the solution calls myself.attend(course: swiftCourse) (solution Sources/DeveloperLib/Client.swift line 19). This signature mismatch will cause the client call to fail to compile and confuses students because the API differs between specification/template and the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution implementation match the problem statement and template by changing the solution's method signature to: func attend(course: Course?) { ... } and adapt its body accordingly so Client.main() can call myself.attend(course: swiftCourse). Alternatively, if the extra forCredit parameter is intentional, update the problem statement, template, and all call sites to document and use attend(course: Course?, forCredit: Bool).
